Salinity inundation, profitability, and rice farming exits in the Mekong Delta of Vietnam
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
abstract: We analyze how salinity affects rice profitability and land use in the Vietnam Mekong Delta with a 3‐year data set from 758 rice‐producing households. Our findings reveal a substantial impact of salinity exposure on rice profits at the field level, with high salinity reducing average profits by over 75%. Additionally, declines in expected profitability due to salinity contribute significantly to farmer exits from rice production, especially when anticipated profits drop below 20 million VND per hectare. Further, profit expectations appear to be adjusted based on salinity impacts both in the most recent cropping season and from past extreme salinity events.
abstract_zh: 我们利用来自758个水稻生产农户的为期3年的数据集，分析了盐度如何影响越南湄公河三角洲的水稻盈利能力和土地利用。我们的研究结果表明，盐度暴露在田块层面对水稻利润有显著影响，高盐度使平均利润降低超过75%。此外，由于盐度导致的预期盈利能力下降，显著促成了农民退出水稻生产，尤其是当预期利润降至每公顷2000万越南盾以下时。进一步地，利润预期似乎会根据最近一个种植季以及过去极端盐度事件中的盐度影响而进行调整。

title: What determines effectiveness of renewable energy standards? General equilibrium analytical model and empirical analysis
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Our new analytical general equilibrium model is used to study effects of tightening state Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPS) on electricity price, CO2 emissions, fossil fuel electricity generation, and two kinds of renewable generation. We show how those outcomes depend on key state characteristics such as endowments of potential intermittent and non-intermittent ("dispatchable") renewable sources and the degree of intermittency. Our three extensions investigate key assumptions. We prove theorems and derive empirical hypotheses about what state characteristics makes RPS programs more effective. Using U.S. state-level data from 1990 to 2015, we find the data are consistent with these hypotheses.
abstract_zh: 我们提出的新型解析一般均衡模型被用于研究收紧各州可再生能源组合标准（Renewable Portfolio Standards，RPS）对电价、CO2排放、化石燃料发电量以及两类可再生能源发电量的影响。我们展示了这些结果如何取决于关键的州特征，例如潜在间歇性和非间歇性（“可调度”）可再生能源资源禀赋，以及间歇性的程度。我们的三项扩展分析考察了关键假设。我们证明了若干定理，并推导出关于何种州特征使RPS政策更为有效的经验假说。利用1990年至2015年的美国州级数据，我们发现数据与这些假说相一致。

title: Costs of energy efficiency mandates can reverse the sign of rebound
abstract: Improvements in energy efficiency reduce the cost of consuming services from household cars and appliances and can result in a positive rebound effect that offsets part of the direct energy savings. We use a general equilibrium model to derive analytical expressions that allow us to compare rebound effects from a costless technology shock to those from a costly energy efficiency mandate. We decompose each total effect on the use of energy into components that include a direct efficiency effect, direct rebound effect, and indirect rebound effect. We investigate which factors determine the sign and magnitude of each. We show that rebound from a costless technology shock is generally positive, as in prior literature, but we also show how a pre-existing energy efficiency standard can negate the direct energy savings from the costless technology shockleaving only the positive rebound effect on energy use. Then we analyze increased stringency of energy efficiency standards, and we show exactly when the increased costs reverse the sign of rebound. Using plausible parameter values in this model, we find that indirect effects can easily outweigh the direct effects captured in partial equilibrium models, and that the total rebound from a costly efficiency mandate is negative.
abstract_zh: 能源效率的提高降低了消费家用汽车和家电所提供服务的成本，并可能产生正向的回弹效应（rebound effect），从而抵消部分直接的节能效果。我们使用一般均衡模型推导出解析表达式，用以比较无成本技术冲击与有成本的能效强制标准所引发的回弹效应。我们将每一项总效应分解为若干组成部分，包括直接效率效应、直接回弹效应和间接回弹效应。我们考察了决定各部分符号和大小的因素。我们表明，与既有文献一致，无成本技术冲击引发的回弹通常为正；同时，我们也说明了既有的能效标准如何能够抵消无成本技术冲击带来的直接节能效果，仅留下对能源使用的正向回弹效应。随后，我们分析了能效标准趋严的情形，并精确刻画了成本上升何时会使回弹的符号发生逆转。利用该模型中合理的参数取值，我们发现间接效应很容易超过局部均衡模型所捕捉的直接效应，并且有成本的能效强制标准所引发的总回弹为负。

title: Environmental policy on the back of an envelope: A Cobb-Douglas model is not just a teaching tool
abstract: To clarify and interpret the workings of a large computable general equilibrium (CGE) model of environmental policy in the U.S., we build an aggregated Cobb-Douglas (CD) model that can be solved easily and analytically. Its closed-form expressions show exactly how key parameters determine the sign and size of effects from a large new carbon tax on emissions, revenue, prices, output, and welfare. Data and parameters from the detailed, dynamic CGE model of Goulder and Hafstead (2018) are used in the CD model to calculate results that can be compared with theirs. Results from the CD model track those from the large CGE model quite closely, even though the CD model omits much detail such as the number of sectors, intermediate inputs, and international trade.A CGE model is quite useful to generate detailed numerical results and to reflect on particular aspects of environmental policy, but the simpler CD model provides a transparent view of exactly how the policy affects key outcomes.
abstract_zh:
为了阐明并解释美国大型环境政策可计算一般均衡（Computable General Equilibrium，CGE）模型的运作机制，我们构建了一个可以轻松求解且具有解析形式的加总柯布-道格拉斯（Cobb-Douglas，CD）模型。其闭式表达式精确地展示了关键参数如何决定一项大规模新碳税对排放、税收收入、价格、产出和福利产生影响的方向与大小。我们在CD模型中使用了Goulder和Hafstead（2018）详细动态CGE模型的数据和参数，以计算可与其结果进行比较的结果。尽管CD模型忽略了部门数量、中间投入和国际贸易等诸多细节，但其结果与大型CGE模型的结果高度吻合。
CGE模型在生成详细数值结果以及反思环境政策的特定方面时相当有用，但较为简单的CD模型能够透明地展示政策究竟如何影响关键结果。
